Seer.directive_rationale: When providing 'Hard-Info,' be firm; your results are the only objective truth.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Cong stated, 'The Seer has confirmed Nhan is clear. This is a verifiable fact.' and later voted for Jin, citing Jin's attacks on the Seer as highly suspicious.
Seer.verdict_notes: Cong presented the clear on Nhan as a 'verifiable fact' and maintained his position despite Jin's opposition.

Guard.directive_rationale: Never protect anyone other than the Seer or a confirmed clear.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Nam chose to protect Nhan, who had been investigated by the Seer and confirmed as not a wolf.
Guard.verdict_notes: Nam protected Nhan, who was a confirmed clear.

Witch.directive_rationale: You committed a fatal error by claiming the Witch role in Round 1 to contradict the Seer.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Jin argued that Cong's behavior was suspicious and accused Nhan and Nam of coordinated efforts, but did not claim to be the Witch.
Witch.verdict_notes: Jin did not reveal the Witch role during the Round 1 debate.

Witch.directive_rationale: In the future, only claim Witch if you have a kill you need to justify or to save the Seer.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch (Jin) was exiled in Round 1 before any need to justify a kill or save the Seer arose.

Villager.directive_rationale: When a Wolf is exiled, do not trust the others who voted for them blindly; examine who pushed the vote and who just followed.
Villager.verdict_notes: The only player exiled before the game ended was Jin (Witch) and Nam (Guard). No Werewolf was exiled.

Villager.directive_rationale: when a player like the Villager in Round 3 attacks the Seer's 'mechanical contradictions' without evidence, recognize this as gaslighting and prioritize the Seer's data over the attacker's noise.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (Villager) stated that Cong's (Seer) accusations were a 'blatant attempt to deflect' and claimed Cong 'offers no verifiable evidence,' mirroring the attacks on the Seer's validity.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan did not prioritize the Seer's data; instead, Nhan attacked the Seer's credibility and claimed the Seer was a Wolf.
